newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro-MPs complete air data decision second reading.
newsitem.headline: Euro-MPs complete air data decision second reading.

text.p: The European Parliament completed its second reading on Wednesday of the draft Council decision to set up a reciprocal data exchange on ambient air pollution.
Euro-MPs adopted four of the five amendments recommended by the assembly's environment committee.
Their vote, under the cooperation procedure, was based on a report by British Socialist Anita Pollack on European Commission proposal COM(94)345.

The adopted amendments mainly aimed to increase public access to air pollution data, to make data availability mandatory on request, and to require the Commission to compile a general report summarising the collected data and pointing to any trends.

Deputies rejected an amendment which would have had the Commission submit its implementation report three years after the entry into force of the decision, rather than the five years specified in Article 8 of the Council's common position.
